metadata.name: spl_token_2022
metadata.description: Minimal synthetic Anchor 0.30+ IDL for the SPL Token-2022 program. Covers the four instructions the build-tx plugin needs for the USDC demo; the real program exposes many more. Instruction names match the SPL Token convention (camelCase); discriminators are omitted because the plugin computes them as sha256('global:<snake_case_name>')[0..8] per bean l59k. SPL Token's native wire format uses a u8 instruction index — operators integrating the real program must provide the correct encoding override in the IDL (future bean); this sample is sufficient for the build-tx plugin's IDL-lookup + discriminator-block + simulation path.
